_about: Example --config file. Keys set here replace the defaults (see `claude-code-usage-audit rules`); prependRules, appendRules and extraMarkers add to them. run-worker.ps1 and my-agent-setup are placeholders: put in the script you hand work to other agents with, and the folder where you maintain your agent setup.

prependRules.note: my own launcher script (it lives under ~/.claude/skills, so without this rule running it would count as orchestration)
